label: def:arc-space
title: Arc space $\mathcal{L}(X)$ of the brane tower
html:
Definition. Arc space \mathcal{L}(X) of the brane tower

Definition. Let X be a variety in \mathbf{C}—typically the exceptional divisor of a collision locus, the singular state of a tangled braid, or a fluid blow-up. Its n-th jet scheme \mathcal{L}_n(X) rigorously represents the functor:

  R \longmapsto \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathrm{Sch}}\!\bigl(\mathrm{Spec}\,R[t]/(t^{n+1}),\; X\bigr).

The arc space of X is the formal inverse limit:

  \mathcal{L}(X) = \varprojlim_{n} \mathcal{L}_n(X).
